info.title: Digital Examination & OSM Platform
info.description: Backend API for AI-assisted Digital Examination & On-Screen Marking Platform

post.summary: Log in and obtain JWT access token (A1)
post.description:
Authenticate user using email and password.
Returns access_token, token_type, expires_in, and user profile.
Admin only: Create a new user account (admin, examiner, or moderator).

get.summary: List users with filters and pagination (U2)
get.description: Admin only: List users with optional role and status filters and pagination.

patch.description:
Admin only: Edit user attributes or deactivate account.
Self-deactivation is rejected.

get.description: E2: List exams. Admins and moderators see all; examiners see exams with assigned answers.

schema.title: Response List Exams Endpoint Api V1 Exams Get

post.description: E1: Create a new exam in draft status.

get.description: E3: Get exam details with question, sheet, and answer counts.

patch.description: E4: Update exam details or settings.

post.description: E5: Transition exam lifecycle state (draft -> evaluation -> moderation -> completed).
Q1: Add a question to an exam in draft status.

get.description: Q2: List questions with rubrics for an exam.

schema.title: Response Get Questions Endpoint Api V1 Exams  Id  Questions Get

patch.description: Q3: Edit a question in draft status.

delete.description: Q4: Delete a question (draft exams only, no answers).

put.description: R1: Create or replace a question's rubric with criteria validation.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Search term for roll number or full name
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Search term for roll number or full name

post.description: AS1: Upload a student's answer sheet (PDF or JPEG/PNG pages).

get.description: AS2: List answer sheets with progress (Admin only).
AS3: Get answer sheet detail, pages, and answers (role-aware blind marking).

put.description: AS4: Map page ranges to questions; sets sheet status to mapped.

schema.title: Response Map Page Ranges Endpoint Api V1 Answer Sheets  Id  Mapping Put

get.description: AS5: Stream a page image (authorized for admin, assigned examiner, or moderator).

post.description: AS6: Assign unmarked answers to examiners (by_sheet or by_question).

O1: Batch OCR. Default: all pending/failed attempted answers.
Returns 202 { "queued": count }.

O2: Re-run OCR for one answer.
Allowed for Admin or the assigned Examiner.

patch.description: O3: Correct OCR text and/or mark it verified.

get.description: O4: Progress counters for OCR, AI, reviews, and marking.

N1: Filterable list of answers.
Examiners only see answers assigned to them.

parameters.name: assigned_to

schema.description: Filter by assigned examiner ('me' or user ID)
schema.title: Assigned To

parameters.description: Filter by assigned examiner ('me' or user ID)

get.description:
N2: Full workspace payload for an answer.
Examiners only access answers assigned to them. First visit tracks opened_at.

post.description:
V1: Run AI evaluation for one answer (synchronous). Admin or the assigned examiner.
Mode comes from the question unless force_standard is set.

get.description: V3: History of AI suggestions for one answer, newest first.

post.description: V2: Batch AI on answers with ocr_status=done and no current suggestion.
M1: Accept the AI suggestion as-is (creates a submitted evaluation, source=ai_accepted).

put.description: M2: Save a draft or submit explicit marks (ai_modified or manual).

post.description: D1: Upload a reference file; chunking/embedding/upsert runs in the background.

get.description: D2: List reference documents with status and chunk count.

schema.title: Response List Reference Documents Endpoint Api V1 Exams  Id  Reference Documents Get

delete.description: D3: Delete the file, DB row and its vectors.

post.description:
AN1: Run anomaly detectors for the given exam.
Idempotent via dedupe_key.

get.description: AN2: List anomalies for an exam.

patch.description: AN3: Dismiss or reopen an anomaly with a note.

get.description: MD1: Flagged answers with anomaly summaries, highest severity first.

post.description: MD2: Confirm or override examiner's marks. Resolves answer's open anomalies.

get.description:
Health check endpoint returning service status and database connectivity.
Always returns HTTP 200 for liveness monitoring.
Convenience alias for /health under the api/v1 namespace.

verified_text.title: Verified Text
verified_text.description: Corrected transcript of the student's handwritten answer

ocr_verified.title: Ocr Verified
ocr_verified.description: Flag indicating human examiner has verified the text

answer_ids.title: Answer Ids
answer_ids.description: Optional subset of answer IDs to process. If omitted, all pending/failed attempted answers in the exam are queued.

queued.title: Queued
queued.description: Number of answers queued for OCR processing

force_standard.title: Force Standard
force_standard.description: Skip reference retrieval for a reference_grounded question. Logged as mode_requested='standard'.
